Title: H. Pylori: 1 in 3 Americans Has It, Don't Know - Why Treatment Just Changed

Description:
About one in three US adults carries H. pylori, often without knowing it until an ulcer or chronic stomach pain shows up. Antibiotic resistance to clarithromycin, metronidazole, and levofloxacin has climbed above 30%, so doctors now start with bismuth quadruple therapy (a stomach-acid reducer + bismuth + two antibiotics for 14 days) instead of the old single-antibiotic regimens.

If you've had a stomach ulcer, unexplained stomach pain, or a family history of stomach cancer, ask your doctor about testing — a breath, stool, or blood test can confirm it.
